author: reek
body: A showcase of Codex DB's relational query syntax. Tables are typed values. Queries are expressions. The compiler checks everything.

author: reek
body: These were written with a `|>` pipeline operator, which Codex does not have -- the lexer reads it as `|` followed by `>`. They were also written as though each RelOp constructor took its arguments first and the piped relation last, where every one of them takes the source relation FIRST (`RelFilter (RelOp) (Predicate)`). So the plans read bottom-up as let chains, which is the same shape the pipeline was reaching for and needs no operator.
